notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (User-agent: * / Allow: /) permits fetching; no Claude-bot-specific disallow. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl) of homepage returned only a Next.js app-shell (349KB, zero rendered nav links, zero __NEXT_DATA__/API JSON visible) - site is fully client-rendered, so escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless Chromium for the whole pass. TREE: built the full category tree from the rendered mega-menu (HOME top-nav section: Bed Linen / Table Linen / Floor Covering / Kitchen & Dining / Decor / Lighting / Furniture groups, plus the parallel READY TO SHIP top-nav section's own 'Home Linen' and 'Home Essentials' groups for the Jaypore-label-only subset). Confirmed each leaf via its own rendered breadcrumb (Home > Group > Leaf) and on-page H1/listing header - a couple of leaf loads (floor-covering, curtains) needed a retry after the client render did not settle in time; both resolved cleanly on retry. QTY: took the exact '- N product(s)' listing-header text rendered on each leaf page (e.g. 'BED LINEN > Cushion Covers - 1080 products'); two Ready-To-Ship leaves (jaypore-bedsheets, jaypore-quilts) explicitly rendered 'No Products found' so qty=0 per the zero-product-category rule. Parent group pages (bed-linen, table-linen, floor-covering) show an aggregate count across all children (e.g. bed-linen=1562) and were NOT recorded as rows since valid subcategory leaves exist for each (parent-URL rule) - they are grouping rows only. EXCLUDED: Basket (/c/basket, Home>Decor>Basket, 40 products - sample items are decorative brass/jute/seagrass/wood accent baskets and a tray, site places it under the Decor menu alongside Vases/Urli/Wall Accents, not under Storage/Utility - storage.md S5 says a decorative basket with no meaningful storage function follows its own website category, so excluded from Storage here); Decorative Box (/c/decorative-box, Home>Decor>Decorative Box, 20 products, on-page copy explicitly calls them 'decorative organizer boxes' - decorative accessory, excluded per storage.md S24); all Kitchen & Dining siblings of Utility & Storage (Tray, Bowls, Serveware, Cutlery, Plates, Platters, Coasters & Trivets, Mug, Cup, Jar, Bottle, Bakeware, Cake Stand) and all Decor/Lighting/Furniture/Jewelry/Saree/apparel/footwear/gifting nav sections - out of scope for both Textile and Storage. Utility & Storage (/c/utility-storage) is included in Storage with MEDIUM confidence and a flag: it sits directly under the Kitchen & Dining nav group (not under a dedicated Storage/Organization section) and its sample product mix is genuinely mixed (Nut Bowls, Tray/Platter, Kitchenware alongside 'White Marble Storage' and 'Rattan Hand Crafted Storage') - included because the page's own title/breadcrumb explicitly names it Utility & Storage and it contains genuine storage-purpose SKUs, but the mix keeps confidence at MEDIUM per storage.md S42 ambiguity-handling. No dedicated Storage/Organizers/Wardrobe/Shelving/Rack/Bin nav node exists anywhere else on the site (checked the full flattened /c/ link list, ~400 links, and the full mega-menu render). No duplicate URLs across the Textile/Storage arrays; the Ready-To-Ship 'Home Linen' leaves are genuinely separate listing pages/URLs from the main HOME 'Bed Linen'/'Table Linen'/'Floor Covering' leaves (own-brand-only filtered subset), not duplicates of them, so both were kept.
